name: Modify Memory
description:
Concentration, up to 1 minute.

Roll Awareness vs Awareness against a creature within short range. If you or your allies have harmed the creature within the past day, its roll is favored.

On a win, the creature enters a trance, becoming senseless to its surroundings. If the creature takes damage or is targeted by another spell, the trance ends. While the trance lasts, you may speak aloud (in 5 second increments if in combat, or while the spell lasts if out of combat), describing an event they experienced within the past day. You may change, remove or invent details as you choose, or even remove the event entirely. If the creature can understand you, and if the description is not illogical, it accepts the modified memory as real when it comes out of the trance.

On a loss, the creature knows you attempted to meddle with its memories, and you cannot target it with this spell for 1 day.

Describe how you explore the creature's memories.
successes:
✨: You may modify their memory of one additional event.

🌞: You may modify up to three memories that occurred within the past year.
